base_setup_commands: apt-get install -y -qq cmake libblas-dev liblapack-dev gfortran libpng-dev python3-dev git curl python3-pip python3.11-venv
setup_runtime_commands: pip install numpy pandas scipy scikit-image scikit-learn statsmodels matplotlib pyyaml webcolors Pillow nibabel

prepare_commands: pip install numpy pandas scipy scikit-image scikit-learn statsmodels matplotlib pyyaml webcolors Pillow nibabel antspyx pytest
runtime_profile.notes: Pre-built antspyx wheel installed from PyPI to avoid complex C++ build. Tests should be run with the venv activated and from a directory other than /workspace to avoid local source shadowing the installed package.

notes: ANTsPy requires ITK and ANTs C++ libraries. Using pre-built antspyx wheel from PyPI (version 0.6.3) to avoid complex compilation during benchmark setup. Git and curl are explicitly included in system packages. The local /workspace source directory shadows the installed ants module, so tests should run with PYTHONPATH adjusted or from outside /workspace.
